Method.name: ProcessHttpsRequest
CallTwilioGetPhoneType
Method.Implementation:
#dim response As %String
Set phNumber=pRequest.phoneNumber Set operType=pRequest.operationType
Set httprequest=##class(%Net.HttpRequest).%New() Set httprequest.ContentType="application/json" Set httprequest.Https="1" Set httprequest.Location = ..Adapter.URL Set credSettings = ..Adapter.Credentials Set cred=##class(Ens.Config.Credentials).%OpenId(credSettings) Set httprequest.Username= cred.Username Set httprequest.Password= cred.Password set httprequest.Timeout=..Adapter.ResponseTimeout
set url = ..Adapter.URL_phNumber_"?Type="_operType Set httprequest.Location = url $$$TRACE("Location: "_httprequest.Location) Set httprequest.SSLConfiguration = ..Adapter.SSLConfig $$$TRACE("SSL Config: "_httprequest.SSLConfiguration)
set status = httprequest.Get(url)
if $$$ISERR(status) { do $system.OBJ.DisplayError() Quit status } else { $$$TRACE(" Twilio service..Get Request successful..") set response=httprequest.HttpResponse $$$TRACE("StatusLine: "_response.StatusLine) set pResponse=##class(Ens.StringResponse).%New()
set len = httprequest.HttpResponse.ContentLength set respData = httprequest.HttpResponse.Data.Read() $$$TRACE("RESP DATA (Twilio Service): "_respData)
set response=httprequest.HttpResponse $$$TRACE("StatusLine: "_response.StatusLine) set statusLine = response.StatusLine set statusCode = "" set statusDesc = "" if (statusLine'=""){ set statusCode=$piece(statusLine," ",2) set statusDesc=$piece(statusLine," ",3) } $$$TRACE("StatusCode: "_statusCode) $$$TRACE("StatusDesc: "_statusDesc)
set respJSONstring = respData set consumedJSONobj = ##class(%DynamicAbstractObject).%FromJSON(respJSONstring) if statusCode '="404"{ set jsonRespPhType = (consumedJSONobj.%Get("carrier")).%Get("type")
$$$TRACE(" jsonRespPhType: "_jsonRespPhType)
set lowcasePhType = $ZCONVERT(jsonRespPhType,"L") if lowcasePhType ="mobile"{ set pResponse.StringValue = "CELLPHONE" }elseif (lowcasePhType="landline"){ set pResponse.StringValue = "HOMEPHONE" }else{ $$$TRACE(" PhoneType from Twilio Service is ["_jsonRespPhType_"] is not a CELLPHONE or HOMEPHONE.. Assigning phonetype to ALTPHONE..") set pResponse.StringValue = "ALTPHONE" } }else{ if (statusCode ="404"){ $$$TRACE(" StatusCode from Twilio Service is 404 (invalid phone).. Assigning phonetype to NOPHONE...") set pResponse.StringValue = "NOPHONE" }else{ set jsonStatusErrorCode = (consumedJSONobj.%Get("status")) set jsonStatusErrorMsg = (consumedJSONobj.%Get("message")) $$$TRACE(" StatusErrorCode:"_jsonStatusErrorCode) $$$TRACE(" StatusErrorMsg:"_jsonStatusErrorMsg) Set status = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).HddDataError("Op-Twilio-Json-Wsrc"," ERROR#"_jsonStatusErrorCode_" ERROR MSG: "_jsonStatusErrorMsg) // set status=$$$ERROR(" ERROR#"_jsonStatusErrorCode_". Phone number lookup failed in Twilio. Error Message: "_jsonStatusErrorMsg) Quit status } } } quit status
